source_locators.financials: Consolidated financial statements, notes 2.1 and 2.2; pre-award supplier segment and geographical markets
source_locators.group_cash_flow: Consolidated statement of cash flows, 2021 column; consolidated income statement
source_locators.kpis: Key figures and board report, 2021 and 2020 year-end columns
source_locators.audit: Independent auditor's report, opinion on consolidated IFRS financial statements

limitations: Historical 2021 financial statements, not current market size, current pricing or 2026 performance.
Recognized revenue is not a bank settlement ledger; customer counts and ARR are management KPIs, not individual audited payments.
Segment EBITDA excludes depreciation/amortization and group-level items; group cash flows cannot be allocated to the supplier segment from this source.
ARR divided by year-end supplier count is a rounded aggregate proxy, not a list price, cohort retention or individual customer revenue. Acquisitions and mix changes prevent causal inference.
No AgentMine customers, revenue, delivery cost, willingness to pay or market share inferred.
